title: ZOE catalog benchmark result
description: One run of `zoe-bench catalog`, which `just bench catalog` writes (ADR 0054, the family catalog): the catalog mirror and the text index of zoe serve on one catalog fixture, through the protocol, from a client that runs no Python, on one machine. Results are numbers about a synthetic corpus, never data. It holds no host name, user name, path, address or password. A number that its counter does not give is null, never 0. A latency counts only for an answered query.

bytes.description: A number of bytes, or null when the counter does not give it.

seconds.description: A time in seconds, or null when the run does not give it.

reasons.description: A count for each reason or kind, keyed by its name.

spread.description: The p50, the p99 and the maximum of a set of times; null for an empty set.

cell.description: One cell: the queries of one set of plans at one concurrency, for a time.

name.description: The name of the cell, such as c16, or a text variant.

concurrency.description: The connections that send the queries.

answered.description: The queries with an answer: no reply f, no reply e.

p50_seconds.description: The median latency of the answered queries.

p99_seconds.description: The 99th percentile of the same latencies.

max_seconds.description: The longest of the same latencies.

qps.description: The answered queries per second of the cell.

errors.description: The replies e by kind, and the calls that failed as call.

by_query.description: The answers of each query of the cell, by name, in the order of the calls: in the cells of the scenario intersect.

name.description: The name of the query in the query set.

p50_seconds.description: The median latency of its answers.

p99_seconds.description: The 99th percentile of the same latencies.

max_seconds.description: The longest of the same latencies.

probe.description: The probe of the invalidation hub: one connection commits a small object at a short interval, another one listens.

missed.description: The commits whose invalidation did not come.

invalidation_delay.description: The time from the begin of a commit to its invalidation at the listener.

scenario.description: One scenario, with the memory of the server and the gauges of the mirror after it.

rss_bytes.description: The resident set of zoe serve after the scenario.

peak_rss_bytes.description: The peak of the resident set of zoe serve since its start.

build_seconds.description: zoe_catalog_mirror_build_seconds of the catalog: the build time of the mirror.

cold.description: The cold start: the pages of the store leave the page cache, then zoe serve opens it. Until the mirror is ready, the replies are not_ready.

page_cache_dropped_bytes.description: The bytes of the store that left the page cache.

listening_seconds.description: The time from the spawn of zoe serve to its line listening.

mirror_ready_seconds.description: The time from the spawn to zoe_catalog_mirror_ready.

first_answer_seconds.description: The time from the spawn to the first answer.

text_ready_seconds.description: The time from the spawn to the first answer of the text index.

refusals.description: The replies f before the answers, by reason.

first_answers.description: The latency of the first answered queries.

hub_during_build.description: The delay of the invalidations while the mirror builds.

intersect.description: The five-index intersections with a sort of the fixture, warm (G2); and a full page of brains.

page.description: A full page of brains: with all the columns, without the date columns and without rows; and the time that a client takes to decode and encode the reply. Null when the plans have no intersection with columns.

date_columns.description: The names of the columns that hold a date.

mix.description: The plans of the query log, warm; then the path queries with many overridden rows, and the invalidations while the mirror rebases.

native.description: The lines that the mirror answers.

native_share.description: native divided by lines, or null for no line.

client_reasons.description: The lines that the client sends to the Python path, by reason.

server_reasons.description: The lines that the server refuses, by reason.

text.description: The text queries in each variant, in each mode of the text indexes, warm (G4).

mode.description: enhanced or compat, or null when the plans give no mode.

filter_rids.description: The rids of the filter of text_query.

commits.description: The commits of text deltas during the run.

text-rebuild.description: The rebuild of the text index in the store with one indexing thread, from a store without text/.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema. A change that a reader of the previous version cannot read increments it.

machine.description: The machine of the client and of zoe serve. It holds no host name, user name or path.

name.description: A stable name for the machine, used as a path segment in the results repository.

memory_bytes.description: The physical memory, or 0 when the system does not give it.

started.description: When the run started, in UTC, to the second.

commit.description: The ZOE commit of the run, or null when it is not known.

dirty.description: True when the tree held changes that the commit does not; false when it held none; null when git fails. Only false is publishable (ADR 0054).

catalog.description: The catalog fixture of the run. Its key names the family catalog.

name.description: The name of the fixture, used as a path segment in the results repository.

preset.description: The preset whose spec equals the spec of the fixture, such as catalog-1m, else custom. Only catalog-1m is publishable.

counts.description: The counts of the fixture: its entries, and the entries of each index and of each column.

rounds.description: The least rounds of the calls of each connection in a cell.

ready_timeout_seconds.description: The longest wait for the mirror and for the text index.

text_commits.description: The commits of text deltas of the scenario text.

text_batch.description: The text deltas of each of these commits.

text_pause_seconds.description: The time between two of these commits.

rebase_seconds.description: The time that the probe of the invalidations runs after the last write of the mix.

server.description: zoe serve: its settings, and its memory and the gauges of the mirror at the end of the run.

catalog_memory.description: --catalog-memory of zoe serve, such as 8GB, or null for its default.

adr_0059_line_bytes.description: The memory of a catalog of 1,000,000 entries that ADR 0059 states.

over_adr_line.description: True when mirror_bytes is above that line; null when mirror_bytes is null.

metrics.description: The scrape of GET /metrics of the admin port during the whole run.

scenarios.description: One entry per scenario, in the order of the run: cold, intersect, mix, text, text-rebuild. A full run holds intersect, text, mix and cold.
